name: BACH_0087
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (42%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged out-of-distribution image quality (19% reliability) overlaps a close split between InSitu (42%) and Invasive (39%) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 42%, Invasive 39%, Normal 15%, Benign 3% | InSitu and Invasive nearly tied |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage) | Unseparated at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 19% reliability, 100% OOD percentile [F6] | Flagged atypical input; suspect read |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree (false) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (100% neighbor agreement) [F5] | All five reference neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Strongest pro-invasive score (+0.77) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasive score (-0.60) [F3]; 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Pushes away from invasive (-0.48) [F4]; 20/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 2, 5) · context · 94% tumor cells (100th percentile) [F7]; 0th percentile nuclear size [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); mitoses and normal lobules are unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 5, 2, or 1 contain stromal invasion (Invasive 39%; Invasive contrast case BACH_0055 is 77% similar).
- Out-of-distribution image quality (19% reliability) distorts model embeddings, or unremarkable tissue explains the read (Normal 15%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 2, 1**: Highest heatmap risk (78%, 66%, 59%) and tumor density [F8]; inspect for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 7, 8, 11**: Validated benign stroma/fat; assess myoepithelium and consider drafted p63, calponin, ER, CK5/6, or recut.
3. **Regions 2, 5, 6**: Verify mitotic figures and necrosis directly, as both model concept scores are unreliable.
